item.title: [IGNITE-1395] REST HTTP module prints out unnecessary message
item.description:
1. Copy directory libs/optional/ignite-rest-http in libs/
2. Start node in quiet mode.
3. The output is following:

...
[17:49:42] Quiet mode.
...
[17:49:50] Security status [authentication=off, communication encryption=off]
2015-09-09 17:49:50.789:INFO::main: Logging initialized @9841ms
[17:49:52] To start Console Management & Monitoring run ignitevisorcmd.{sh|bat}
[17:49:52]
[17:49:52] Ignite node started OK (id=54eee2db)
[17:49:52] Topology snapshot [ver=1, servers=1, clients=0, CPUs=8, heap=1.0GB]
...

The message after security status is generated by REST HTTP module.
1. It has wrong format
2. It should not be printed in quiet mode
item.summary: REST HTTP module prints out unnecessary message

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment: I will have a look at this issue. Can you please assign me?

"Logging initialized ..." line is printed out because org.eclipse.jetty.util.log.Slf4jLog requires org.slf4j.Logger, fails to find it and initializes StdErrLog with INFO level. The attached patch is a simple fix for the issue.
